name: Leicester Maycraft
original_name: レスター・メイクラフト
source: Skillful artificer, part of the Clan "Oasis". Likes to add secret functions (especially beams) to the items he makes. Very creative and perceptive, his item naming sense is not so imaginative. Thanks to the constant skinship of his mother and to living with women is somewhat resistant to the opposite gender.
